author: Eugene Field
title: Poems of Childhood
edition: New York: Charles Scribner’s Sons, September 1904. This collection reprints earlier English poems; no illustrations or later editorial matter are included. Transcription treatment: HTML inline emphasis is represented as plain text; page numbers, image captions, illustrations, and digitizer boilerplate are excluded. Prose line-wrap whitespace is collapsed within each paragraph; verse line breaks and stanza boundaries are retained, with indentation whitespace normalized. Original wording, spelling, and punctuation are retained, including apparent historical or transcription oddities.

rights.basis: The selected English literary text was published in 1904, before 1931, and its maximum 95-year US publication term has expired as of 2026. Project Gutenberg explicitly identifies this ebook as public domain in the USA.

acquisition.method: Downloaded Project Gutenberg HTML pg75578-images.html from the aleph.pglaf.org mirror of the Gutenberg cache and converted with a scratch HTML parser: h1–h6 become headings, p elements paragraphs, stanza divs and br-broken lines stanzas (one line per printed line, indentation dropped), HTML entities decoded, inline emphasis rendered as plain text, prose whitespace folded to single spaces. Omitted throughout: the Project Gutenberg header, footer and licence, page-number anchors, illustrations and their captions, the title page, copyright list, contents and list of illustrations. Kept: every poem from the half-title "POEMS OF CHILDHOOD" to the end, with speaker labels as paragraphs.
